09/11/26    Dev, Test and Prod environments are provisioned and live in Azure. SQL MI for Content Dev and Test have been provisioned. Dev SQL migration has been completed with all necessary config and access changes completed. Further planning is required for Test and Production migrations. On prem Prod1 SQL servers need to be upgraded to be compatible with SQL MI Link. New nodes to be created and added to cluster. A new Azure SQL database is also required to be compatible with running SQL MI Link in Production.

The GoAnywhere VM has been migrated to Azure and connectivity is being configured. It will be brought up with a different name to the live on prem VM in order to test connectivity. New DNS entries and IP addresses are required. Communications will need to be sent to clients to inform them of the new details. The DR Password State VM is due to be switched to Azure 09/11. Migration of the TeamCity build servers commenced 06/11. Legacy Enterprise and Content infrastructure is being shut down. The Ontology database was migrated to Azure and the backup solution for this is now in place. New VMs for Domain Controllers have been created, these are being set up with required software and firewalls rules created. Non-Prod jump boxes have been created ready for software to be installed. The target to have them available for use is 13/11. Scoping and design work for Cloudflare connectors is progressing. Dataedo solution may be moved to a SaaS solution in Jan '27. Need to confirm with Sean Taylor. Azure hybrid extractor solution is being built, this will replace the CUBEPOCSCR cluster.

09/11/26 Database pipelines have been completed in GitHub and tested in environments up to Test. Minor changes are required following the most recent UAT release. Compression of the large tables in Enterprise has reduced data volumes and data files have been compressed. Compression has been implemented in UAT and Production. Failover between SQL VMs and SQL MI has been tested with Book issues resolved. The failover process has been documented ready for UAT and Production failovers. Planning for BCP/DR testing and execution of testing is to be completed by 13/11.
